items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It's in Ross Russell's book about Charlie Parker. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know. It's the first of me hearing.

ctx.x: No, I haven't heard about that. It might have been, but I never heard...
It's in Ross Russell's book about Charlie Parker. I can't remember which band it was. There was one incident like that.
I don't know. It's the first of me hearing. It wasn't Jap Allen. George Lee? Clarence Love? Andy Kirk? Bennie Moten? Blue Devils?
